svg.title: Unlimited preset spectra
svg.desc: Measured power spectral density of the hf_fast, hf, hf_robust, hf_weak and fm presets with the 99 percent occupied bandwidth.
svg.text: Welch PSD of the data frames of 256 random bytes, real Encoder at 8 kHz, 7.8 Hz resolution.
Shaded: the 99% occupied bandwidth (0.5% of the power below it, 0.5% above).
audio frequency (Hz); gray: 300–2700 Hz passband; purple tick: f_ref; rows in dB relative to their peak
